findings.passage: In 2025, I supported Senate Enrolled Act 10, which makes Indiana's already strong voter ID laws even stronger by removing loosely regulated college IDs as a legal form of voter ID to ensure only Indiana residents are voting in our elections.
findings.note: In his column he describes his support for SEA 10 (2025), which removes college IDs as a valid voter ID. Column is undated; the same column names 2026 bills as 'this year'.
subjects: college or student ID as voter ID

findings.passage: That is why I have supported many bills to increase election transparency and crack down on voter fraud.
findings.note: General statement in the same column about backing election-integrity bills; also lists SEA 112, SEA 113 (keeping election materials 34 months) and HEA 1680 (2025, paper trail on voting machines).

findings.passage: I also supported House Enrolled Act 1680 (2025) to require all electronic voting machines in Indiana to have a voter-verifiable paper trail and gave the Secretary of State more authority to perform post-election audits.
findings.note: Same column. Says he supported HEA 1680 (2025): paper trail on voting machines and more audit authority.
subjects: voting machine paper trail and audits

findings.passage: I also supported Senate Enrolled Act 113, which changes the amount of time election materials are preserved in county election offices from the current requirement of 22 months after an election to 34 months.
findings.note: Same column. Says he supported SEA 113: election materials kept 34 months instead of 22, so they can serve as evidence in election fraud cases.

findings.passage: To make sure your vote counts, I have supported laws that strengthen identification requirements for mail-in ballots, increase election security and ensure elections in Indiana are fair.
findings.note: Column by the senator before the 2024 general election (page says the election is on Nov. 5 and registration deadline is Oct. 7). Says he supported laws that strengthen ID requirements for mail-in ballots.
